regime_month.recipe: count of days, mean change_risk_5d, mean anomaly_pct, mean vol_20 per calendar month and regime label, from regimes.parquet joined to features.parquet

regime_runs.recipe: consecutive same-label stretches: count, mean length in trading days, median, and the longest observed episode

siren_exceedance.recipe: days with anomaly_pct >= 90 and >= 98, and the month's maximum

event_window.recipe: mean change_risk_5d and anomaly_pct over the five trading days before and the five after each scheduled event in events.csv

ledger_window.recipe: forecasts, resolved count and Brier score over the last 7, 30, 90 days and all sealed rows
